description: This Java source file defines a Wear OS service called ListenerService that extends WearableListenerService. It handles inbound data and message events from connected wearable devices, processes data related to tourist attractions, and shows notifications accordingly.

classes.name: ListenerService
classes.description: A service extending WearableListenerService to handle data changes and messages from wearable devices, send notifications about tourist attractions.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming data change events, checks if the data path matches attractions, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages; clears notifications upon receiving a specific message.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification based on attraction data received via wearable data events.
